note: BH-10060: the fleet-status `remote_results_pending` counter skips a hub backup json whose own result line is PR_CREATED, PR_MERGED or PR_CLOSED with a GitHub pull URL once the json is older than this many days, the same rule as the pipeline-health staleremote check (BH-9142). The env value wins; when it is unset the lane reads the pipeline-health knob of the same name, so both counters stay equal. 0 turns the rule off. A non-number or a value over 365 falls back to 7.
